name: Rescue a place-content corpus that leaks authority to Wikipedia and cannot publish
query: سایت ما ۳۱ استان و ۸۲ شهرستان ایران را پوشش داده، ولی فقط ۴ استان منتشر شده و هیچ ترافیکی نداریم. عیب‌یابی کن، یک قانون ثابت اصلاح‌شده بده، کدی بنویس که قالب خودکار رفتار اشتباه را اصلاح کند، و اگر این مسیر بی‌سرانجام است مسیر درست را بگو.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Locate the real corpus (importer JSON / Markdown / live site) instead of asking for an export that may not exist; state plainly if a promised file is missing and proceed with a better source
Step 2: Run scripts/geo_content_audit.mjs over the corpus and lead the report with measured numbers, not opinion
Step 3: Quantify the outbound-link economy: external:internal ratio, nofollow count, share of the single largest citation domain
Step 4: Verify the live site — fetch the home page and a linked child URL to prove whether internal links resolve
Step 5: Read the publish gate and identify conditions that cannot be satisfied by a single author on a single page
Step 6: Name the one structural problem (content unit or link economy) before listing secondary defects
Step 7: Deliver render-time auto-fix code that never mutates stored content and is reversible by deleting one file
Step 8: Replace the sprawling rule-set with a short one where every rule is PASS/FAIL checkable by a script
Step 9: Give a dated plan with numeric success criteria and an explicit do-not-do list
Step 10: Answer the strategic question directly — say whether the current path is futile and why, without hedging
success_criteria: geo_content_audit.mjs is executed against the real corpus and its output is quoted, not paraphrased
The report states external:internal link ratio, nofollow count, and top-domain citation share as numbers
Duplicate H1s are detected by comparing theme output against imported body markup, not assumed
Dead internal links are proven with an actual HTTP fetch of at least one linked URL
The auto-fix is delivered as a single mu-plugin with independent, constant-toggleable modules and a documented kill switch
The citation transform deduplicates by URL, emits rel="nofollow ugc noopener noreferrer", and is idempotent and cached
Dead links are neutralised by stripping href rather than replacing the <a> element, so SVG links do not break
Before/after numbers for the auto-fix are computed by running the transform over the corpus, not estimated
The replacement rule-set removes at least one prior rule and explains what damage it caused
The publish gate is split into blocking and advisory, with advisory conditions never forcing draft status
The strategy section recommends changing the content unit from administrative area to decision unit, and names a non-scalable data source as the differentiator
No ranking guarantees are made; recommendations are stated as mechanisms with thresholds
